name: Kanpaku Sengen
source:
The Sonoda Zaibatsu was one of the five major zaibatsu in Japan, which have grown to become prosperous by the Sonoda family.
After the war, the zaibatsu, like others, was dismantled, but a new corporate entity, the Sonoda Foundation, was established.

The Sonoda Foundation, which reunited the former zaibatsu groups, has grown in power and has driven the economy even more than before the war.

The sad news arrived that the general manager of the Sonoda Foundation, Koichiro Sonoda, was in a critical condition.

I am very happy to hear that Koichiro Sonoda, the general manager of the Sonoda Foundation, has fallen critically ill.

With the current general manager gone, a successor is needed.
In other words, the opportunity to seize the real power of the foundation and obtain all the status, honor, and money had arrived.

"There is already a movement within the foundation to select a successor".

My best subordinate, who was the one to announce the news of general Sonoda's critical condition, continued to speak.

"Kukk---He is still alive, but they're so ungrateful.”

I couldn't help but burst into laughter at this predictable move.
At the same time, those who come forward as candidates for the selection of the general manager, etc., can be read in hand.
The Sonoda Foundation has a policy of “taking in those who have talent" and making them the strength of the foundation.
No matter how well-known a person may be, those without power will be shaken out of the foundation.
In this world of the weak and the strong, I was promoted in an exceptional manner and now serve as a director of the foundation.

“Just as well - I've been thinking it's time for a new chairman".
"Hmph, till the usual Director Todo.”

Seeing my grinning face, my subordinate gave me a wince and a look of amusement.

'Speaking of which, I heard that his daughter will be his deputy during the general manager's absence".
"Oh,” I said.

The General's daughter - I've seen her at some of the foundation's parties.
I heard she was still a student.
If she's the deputy, there's no way I won't take advantage of her.

Good. “All right, in order to participate in the selection of successors, let's first go and greet the general's deputy".

I left the room with my subordinates.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006923.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
园田财阀是日本五大财阀之一，由园田家族一手发展壮大。战后，与其他财阀一样，园田财阀被解散，但取而代之的是成立了新的企业实体——园田基金。

园田基金将昔日的财阀集团重新整合，实力不断壮大，比战前更加强力地推动着经济发展。

令人悲伤的消息传来——园田基金的总负责人园田浩一郎病危了。

得知园田基金总负责人园田浩一郎病危的消息，我非常高兴。

现任总负责人一旦离世，就需要选定继任者。换句话说，夺取基金实权、获取一切地位、荣誉和金钱的机会已经到来。

"基金内部已经出现了推选继任者的动向。"

我最得力的部下——正是他通报了园田总负责人病危的消息——继续说道。

"呵呵呵——人还活着呢，他们就这么忘恩负义。"

我不禁对这种意料之中的举动放声大笑。与此同时，谁会站出来成为副候选人，我心里已经有了底。园田基金奉行"吸纳有才之人"的方针，将他们化为基金的力量。无论多么知名，没有实力的人终将被基金淘汰。在这个弱肉强食的世界里，我以破格的速度升迁，如今已担任基金的理事。

"正合我意——我一直觉得是时候换个新理事长了。""哼，果然是老样子啊，藤堂理事。"

看到我咧嘴而笑的面孔，部下露出既无奈又好笑的表情。

"对了，听说总负责人不在期间，将由他的女儿代理职务。""哦？"

总负责人的女儿——我在基金的几次宴会上见过她。听说她还是个学生。既然她代理职务，我怎么可能不加以利用呢。

很好。"好，为了参与继任者选拔，我们先去拜访一下总负责人的代理人吧。"

我带着部下走出了房间。
